gdp_vintage: Sum of state GDP 2022-23 (34 of 36 states and UTs; RBI handbook)

yields.source: Census of India 2011, Primary Census Abstract
yields.label: Food
yields.description: People working on the land at the 2011 census: cultivators plus agricultural labourers, main and marginal workers (Primary Census Abstract). States and districts sum their 2011 sub-districts; a city counts its own urban agglomeration or town.

yields.source: WRI Global Power Plant Database v1.3 (2021)
yields.label: Production
yields.description: Power-plant capacity in megawatts located in the area (WRI Global Power Plant Database, last updated 2021; plants built since are missing). Nuclear plants are left out of this map. A city counts the plants in its own hexes.

yields.source: RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States (NSO / MoSPI)
yields.label: Gold
yields.description: Gross State Domestic Product at current prices, 2022-23, in rupees (NSO state accounts, base 2011-12, as published in the RBI handbook). India publishes no comparable district or city GDP series, so district and city Gold is Pending rather than estimated. States without a 2022-23 figure are Pending.

yields.label: Science
yields.description: Universities with a Wikipedia article in at least 8 languages (Wikidata), counted where their main campus is. A rough signal of research prominence, not a measure of output.

yields.source: UNESCO World Heritage List via Wikidata (queried at build)
yields.label: Culture
yields.description: UNESCO World Heritage properties (Wikidata), counted where they are. Parts of one property inscribed the same year and within 40 km of each other count once.

jobs_source: Census 2011 workers (main + marginal), by the census's four categories
